chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Qāsim, I have narrated it from al-Ḥusayn ibn Aḥmad ibn Idrīs—may Allah be pleased with him—from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, who said: Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Rāzī narrated to us from ʿAbdullāh ibn Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khushnām al-Aṣbahānī, from ʿAbdullāh al-Qāsim.

key_terms.الرَّازِيُّ: A nisbah indicating affiliation with Rayy, used here to identify a narrator.
key_terms.الْأَصْبَهَانِيِّ: A nisbah indicating affiliation with Iṣfahān, used here to identify a narrator.
key_terms.حَدَّثَنَا: He narrated to us; a technical hadith-transmission formula.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; an expression indicating the author’s transmission of the report.
key_terms.عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ: A transmitter whose route of narration is being clarified here.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Qāsim in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the transmission chain for reports narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Qāsim in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It is a sanad statement documenting the author’s route of narration through named transmitters back to ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Qāsim.
